Name: Boarding House Nut Butters
Author: DraconicArcher
Description:
Do you have both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url] and the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Boarding House and Bus Stop Extension[/url]? Could you make nut butter from Hazelnuts or the Walnuts from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]More Trees[/url]﻿, but not Black Walnuts? Well now you can!

Supports making nut butter from all the Boarding House Forageables, Including:
[list]
[*]Black Walnuts
[*]Pine Nuts
[*]Macadamia Nuts
[*]and Pistachios
[/list]
A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]Trent XV[/url]﻿ and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]PPJA Team[/url]﻿ for allowing me to publish my first mod based on their assets.

Downloads.Description: Adds compatability between Boarding House Nuts and the Artisan Valley Butter Churn.
